title: Residential Electricity Supply Off-Peak Rebill Amount
content:
**Amount.** The off-peak rebill amount on a Residential Electricity Supply time-of-use agreement is the billed amount of the most recently posted off-peak energy line less that line's correct amount. The correct amount is the line's kWh multiplied by the agreement's contract rate in cents per kWh, multiplied by the plan's off-peak rate multiplier (as the plan pricing schedule states it for the plan in force) and divided by 100 to give dollars, rounded half up to the cent.

**Assembly and rounding.** A multiplier acts on the over-billed amount; flat amounts are added to that product; the total is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lines)

| Off-peak line billed | kWh | Contract rate | Off-peak rate multiplier | Correct amount | Rebill amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 41.58 USD | 330 | 12.60 cents | 0.00 | 0.00 USD | 41.58 USD |
| 41.58 USD | 330 | 12.60 cents | 0.50, an illustrative figure only | 330 multiplied by 12.60 multiplied by 0.50 is 2,079 cents, or 20.79 USD | 20.79 USD |
| 38.26 USD | 287 | 13.33 cents | 0.25, an illustrative figure only | 956.4275 cents, or 9.564275 USD, rounded to 9.56 USD | 28.70 USD |

**Which line.** The most recently posted off-peak energy line on the agreement, by posting date. The rebill credit is posted against that line's billing cycle.
